top.text: The old growth playbook is dead. Web 1.0 → email. Mobile → app stores. AI era → agent-callable APIs + clean CLIs. If your product can't be summoned reliably by an agent mid-workflow, you don't exist. Can agents discover → evaluate → reliably call your API without human
top.translationZh: 传统的增长套路已经死了。Web 1.0 靠邮件，移动时代靠应用商店，AI 时代靠智能体可调用的 API + 简洁的命令行界面。如果你的产品不能在工作流程中被智能体可靠地召唤出来，那你就等于不存在。智能体能否在无人干预的情况下发现→评估→可靠调用你的 API

top.author: @Bethel_njoku01
top.text: Nobody wakes up thinking: "I really need some multi-board task organization today." Your buyer wakes up thinking: "Why does everything feel chaotic and why is nothing getting finished?" Write to that. Not to your feature list.
top.translationZh: 没人早上醒来会想："我今天真的需要一个多看板任务管理工具。" 你的用户醒来想的是："为什么一切都这么乱？为什么什么事都做不完？" 针对这些痛点写文案，而不是堆砌功能清单。
